Container.Name: BrainCut-Blur
Container.Overview: Blur service for the BrainCut n8n workflow. Automatically blurs faces and license plates in videos via REST API. Called by the n8n workflow and reports back via webhook when done.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: Port used by n8n to reach the blur service.

Config.Name: N8N-Server IP
Config.Description: IP address of your n8n server. The webhook URL is built automatically.

Config.Name: PLATE_MODEL_PATH
Config.Description: Optional path to a .pt model file for license plate detection. Leave empty if not needed.
